problem.title: Deliver SEO under your brand without losing the thread
problem.body: Reselling SEO creates practical questions: who invoices the end client, whose brand appears on the report, what your team receives, and where responsibility changes hands. A useful partner process answers those questions before work reaches the client.

method.title: A handoff your team can inspect
method.intro: Work starts with an agreed scope and stays legible through each review point.

steps.title: Scope
steps.body: Define the site, priorities, audience, deliverables, and approval owner before research or recommendations begin.

steps.title: Evidence
steps.body: Tie findings to pages, searches, crawls, or business constraints so your team can challenge or approve the reasoning.

steps.title: Brand
steps.body: Prepare client-facing material for the agreed agency brand and document what your team needs to present or adapt.

steps.title: Handoff
steps.body: Separate strategy, content, design, and development actions so each owner knows the next review and verification step.

outcome.title: A delivery system built around your client relationship
outcome.body: Your agency remains the commercial owner of the relationship. The invoice path, report brand, access, approvals, and handoffs are agreed as part of the scope rather than left implicit. Partner terms are discussed directly; no public rate is assumed.
points: Reports prepared for the agreed client-facing brand
Clear ownership for invoicing, approvals, and implementation
Handoffs written for strategy, content, design, and development teams
Process proof that can be reviewed without invented performance claims
